title: GTA VI quick guide: release date, price, platforms and size
description: Everything confirmed about GTA VI on one page: when it comes out, at what time, how much it costs, which consoles, how big it is and whether it's coming to PC.

faq.q: When does GTA VI come out?
faq.a: November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. It unlocks at 12:00 a.m. local time in each region.

faq.q: How much does GTA VI cost?
faq.a: In the US, $79.99 for the standard edition and $99.99 for the Ultimate. Both include the Vintage Vice City Pack and one month of GTA+ as preorder bonuses. Prices in other currencies vary by store.

faq.q: Is GTA VI coming to PC?
faq.a: Not confirmed. Take-Two has said any PC or physical disc announcement will come from Rockstar.
The preload is around 210 GB in most regions, plus mandatory patch 1.002.000 (≈1.07 GB on PS5 and ≈2.18 GB on Xbox).

faq.q: What frame rate does GTA VI run at?
faq.a: Rockstar is targeting 30 FPS on PS5, PS5 Pro and Xbox Series. On PS5 Pro it adds PSSR and ray-traced shadows. A 60 FPS mode is not confirmed.

faq.q: Do I need to download anything before playing?
faq.a: Yes. Update 1.002.000, released November 13, is mandatory. Have it downloaded before the 19th.

faq.q: Where can I watch GTA VI live on launch day?
faq.a: YouTube is streaming for 24 hours straight from November 19 at 12:00 a.m. ET (6:00 a.m. in Spain), with more than 30 creators.
